Instead, it spread around the Castellan’s armored body in the form of nine huge rings, and for a moment, the scene looked like a huge crown made of nine rivers of poison.
The ground beneath it began to change color, the stones cracked, and even the ancient white roots that had emerged from the walls turned black where they touched the emerald stream.
Lian carefully watched the scene.
"Now I understand why they call it the Nine-Venom Castellan."
The Unholy creature lowered its right hand, and the rings of poison separated, all of them moving toward him.
But this time, the young Vorhelm did not retreat, he opened his two black wings and then raised his right hand.
[Frost Dominion]
Intense cold spread around him.
The moisture in the air turned into ice crystals, and some of the poisonous streams turned into frozen drops when they entered the cold area.
Of course, not all the poisons disappeared, some streams had mana-based structures and remained active even among the ice crystals.
Lian knew this.
So with another movement, he created several ice walls in the path of the attacks to separate the streams from each other.
The emerald ring struck the first wall, and the ice began to break down, but before the wall was completely destroyed, Lian changed his position.
He passed through an opening he had intentionally created in his defense and rushed toward the Castellan at high speed.
The Unholy creature noticed his movement, and its glowing eyes became fixed on him, then a white stream came out from its crown.
The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes for a moment.
The white steam reached his left forearm, and at that exact moment, the defensive mana layer around his hand began to become unstable.
The white poison did not directly destroy the body; instead, it weakened defensive energy layers and reduced their resistance against later attacks.
But before its effect could spread, Lian cut off the mana flow in that area and moved out of the steam’s path.
"Interesting, this one is for breaking defenses."
Then he clenched his right fist.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
Mana moved in compressed layers along his arm, but just before the impact, the Nine-Venom Castellan quickly moved backward.
This time, unlike what Lian expected from a large monster, the creature’s speed was extremely high.
Its long claw moved toward Lian’s side, the young Vorhelm turned his body, and the claw passed beside his clothes.
But at that exact moment, black steam came out from the Castellan’s fingertips.
Lian immediately moved away, and the steam struck one of the stones behind him, the stone surface turned white and then cracked and collapsed, but its effect was not like the emerald poison.
"Does this one change temperature and sensation?"
With [True Sequence], Lian noticed that the black poison affected heat transfer and the target’s nerve reactions.
After contact, it could make parts of the body numb and even reduce the muscles’ ability to react.
Seven poisons.
And two more streams still remained.
The Castellan stood about ten meters away for a moment, then slowly tilted its head, and its gaze remained fixed on him.
But just as the young Vorhelm was about to attack again, loud laughter came from the west.
"Hahahaha!"
Roderick had appeared from among the broken stones again.

chapters.title: Chapter 658: Dinner Is Served!
paragraphs: Roderick’s body was injured, and the Ascended Mana around his arms was unstable, but even now, his gaze was fixed only on Lian.
"Vorhelm!"
Then he charged toward him with all his strength.
Lian let out a short sigh.
"Are you really not finished yet?" He only raised his left hand.
[Core of the Fallen Star Activated]
Gravity increased along Roderick’s path, and he lost his balance for a moment. But unlike the previous times, instead of correcting his movement, he threw himself forward with all his strength.
Lian moved his head to the side.
The fist passed in front of his face, and then his right knee struck Roderick’s stomach.
BAAANG!
The young Ashen’s body bent backward, but before he could fall to the ground, Lian grabbed his neck with his left hand.
"I’ll tell you one more time."
His voice was calm.
"Get out of my way."
Roderick looked at him for a moment, blood was running down from the corner of his mouth.
Then...
"Ha... hahaha!"
Another loud laugh came from his throat.
"You... you think you can give me orders?!"
The young Vorhelm looked at his face for several seconds and then opened his hand.
But not to release Roderick, instead, he sent a direct strike toward his chest.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
BOOOOOOM!
Roderick was thrown backward, and his body moved several meters through the air before finally striking the western stone wall, causing a large part of it to collapse.
But Lian did not even look at him anymore.
Because the Nine-Venom Castellan was now preparing its next attack, and at the same time, the situation on the northern platform had also changed.
A new group of Withered climbed out from the cracks and moved toward Rindo.
Two landed among them with a long jump and knocked several creatures out of the way, but the number of attackers was still high.
Rindo tightened his grip on his spear.
A Level 32 Withered attacked him.
He used the First Form to redirect the strike and then sent his spear toward the creature’s chest with a short movement.
The blade pierced its body, but before he could pull out his weapon, another Withered approached from the right.
He immediately spun his spear.
[Fourth Form: Azure Dragon Rends the Nine Heavens]
Azure mana spread along the weapon in a spiral movement, and Rindo rose from the ground along with his spear, allowing the attacker’s strike to pass beneath his feet.
Then he turned his body in the air and used the force of his fall to drive the spear’s tip into the creature’s shoulder.
The Withered fell to the ground.
Two immediately blocked its escape path with another strike.
Rindo found an opportunity to deliver the final blow.
SLASH!
The creature stopped moving.
Several experience messages appeared before Rindo, he looked at them for a moment, and then another window opened.
[Level Up!]
He let out a heavy breath.
Level thirty.
He smiled for a moment, but when his gaze fell on the central battlefield, his smile disappeared.
Lian was still fighting among several poisonous streams.
Despite his serious injuries, Roderick was still getting up from among the broken stones.
And the Nine-Venom Castellan... all nine blades of its crown were now glowing.
Rindo lowered his spear for a moment.
Is he really fighting both of them at the same time?
But the scene before him was different from what he had expected.
Lian was not retreating.
Even with hundreds of Withered and two powerful enemies around him, every time he changed his position, one of the attackers was killed or one of the Castellan’s attacks failed.
And the young Vorhelm was still calm.
Lian landed about twenty meters away from the Nine-Venom Castellan.
The ground beneath his feet was covered with a layer of ice, but even this ice was beginning to break down in the places where the emerald poison had struck it.

The Castellan lowered its head slightly and then held its right hand in front of its chest, the eighth opening in its crown lit up, and golden, ash-like steam came out from it and wrapped around the creature’s arm.
Lian watched carefully.
This time, the poison approached one of the injured Withered.
The creature tried to use its natural recovery ability, but the life energy flowing around its wound slowed down greatly.
This poison could disrupt the body’s healing process and mana regeneration, and when combined with the other poisons, even a relatively small wound could become a lasting injury.
Eight poisons.
Only one stream remained.
The almost colorless stream moving in the center of the Castellan’s crown.
Lian stared at it for a moment, and this last one is probably the most dangerous, but at that exact moment, the Castellan moved.
Its four-meter-tall body closed the distance with unexpected speed, and its right claw moved toward his neck.
The young Vorhelm lowered his head, the claw passed above him and cut through part of the stone behind him.
But the Castellan continued its attack, and its left hand moved upward from below while purple poison spread along its fingers.
Lian placed his forearm in front of the strike.
BAAANG!
The impact occurred, but the purple poison immediately tried to enter through the mana flow around his hand.
Before the effect could spread, Lian briefly limited the mana connection in that area and moved away from the Castellan with a quick turn.
Smart.
Unlike ordinary Withered, this creature combined physical strikes with different poisons and changed its attack method as soon as it observed its opponent’s reaction.
The young Vorhelm looked at his left hand for a moment, part of the mana around it was still unstable, but he had not suffered any serious damage.
"Alright."
He raised his head.
"Now it’s my turn."
His body moved.
BOOM!
The stone beneath his feet broke, and in a short moment, the distance between him and the Castellan disappeared, the creature tried to raise its right arm.
But Lian reached it first, and his left fist struck the Castellan’s side.
BAAANG!
The black armor cracked, and the creature moved several meters backward, but before it could lose its balance, Lian had already prepared his second strike.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
Mana gathered in several compressed layers along his right fist, and the strike hit the Castellan’s chest.
CRACK!
The first layer of force was released, part of the armor split open, but he had not pulled his fist back yet, and the second layer was released.
BAAANG!
A new wave of pressure entered the creature’s body through the same point, the Castellan was thrown backward with great force and struck a large stone pillar.
The pillar cracked.
But just as the creature tried to get up from the ground, another wave of pressure activated at the damaged point.
BOOOOM!
The outer part of its chest armor was destroyed.

A rough sound came from the Castellan’s throat, not a roar of anger, but something closer to the sound of a creature that had realized the enemy before it was more dangerous than it had first expected.
Lian lowered his hand.
The monster slowly stood up from among the broken stones, but this time, its movements were more careful.
It looked at the human for several seconds and then lowered its head slightly, the nine poisonous streams began moving around its body again.
The young Vorhelm noticed that the almost colorless stream was becoming denser.
"Are you finally going to use the last one too?"
But just before it activated, a Level 49 Withered approached the Castellan from behind.
The Unholy creature did not even look at it and simply turned its left hand, sending a green stream toward the Withered.
In less than a second, a large part of its body broke down, and then the same dark green threads returned from the place where the creature had been destroyed toward the Castellan.
The ninth poison.
This almost colorless stream activated after the victim’s death and transferred part of its remaining life force to the Castellan.
The absorbed streams entered the crown.
Several cracks in the Castellan’s chest armor closed, and some of its lost mana was restored.
Lian watched the scene for a moment.
"So that’s how you heal yourself."
But he also reached a more important conclusion.
As long as hundreds of Withered remained nearby, the Castellan could recover from some of its injuries by killing weaker creatures.
And considering that all its attention was focused on Lian, it probably intended to use this method to continue the battle.
The young Vorhelm looked at the bodies scattered across the battlefield and then gave a faint smile.
"Unfortunately, I have plans for them too."
At that moment, the southern part of the plain was covered in thick layers of smoke and steam.
Molten lava had risen from the new cracks, and the hot air currents spread gray smoke across a wide area.
Lian examined the situation from above the battlefield.

Rindo and Two were still fighting a group of attackers to the north, One had also taken a defensive position in the southern passage and was still preventing the Withered from passing through the main path.
Both Two and One had leveled up after killing the Withered.
But that was not important right now, what mattered was that everyone was currently busy and no one was paying attention to this area.
A good opportunity.
He slowly descended toward a part of the plain where dozens and hundreds of monster bodies he had killed using Eclipse Energy and Bloodborne Calamity were lying.
He picked up around seven or eight bodies and placed them in his storage space, he wanted to give them to Miranda after leaving this place.
Miranda had previously helped him obtain equipment and some treasures, selling rare Withered specimens could not only bring him income, but also expand their business relationship.
But he had another plan for the remaining bodies.
Smoke and dust covered everything, and now was the best time, especially since he could also make sure the monster would no longer be able to heal itself this way.
Lian opened his hand and took something out of his storage space.
The Devourer Egg.

chapters.title: Chapter 659: Death Is A Mercy
paragraphs: The Devourer Egg.
The mysterious egg he had obtained a long time ago, which increased the growth of the embryo inside it by feeding on monster corpses.
Lian placed it on a relatively stable stone surface.
He looked at its dark shell for a moment and then said with a short smile.
"Well, I think today is your lucky day."
The egg’s shell trembled slightly.
The young Vorhelm pointed toward the bodies scattered around.
"You can eat every corpse around here, just be careful not to get caught or discovered."
For several seconds, nothing happened.
Then the dark lines on the shell began to glow, thin black threads came out from around the egg and spread across the stone surface.

These threads were part of the egg’s feeding system, when they reached the corpses, they slowly broke down the remains of the bodies and transferred the energy and materials needed for the embryo’s growth into the shell.
The first thread reached the corpse of a Withered, and a few moments later, the creature’s body began to break down, and more threads started moving behind it.
Lian watched the scene for a moment.
"Good, you finally got a chance to eat as much as you want."
He knew the egg needed a large amount of monster remains to complete its growth, and now, hundreds of corpses were scattered across the battlefield.
It couldn’t get any better than this.
He kept the egg hidden behind several large rocks and among the thick smoke so that it would remain out of sight of Rindo and the attackers.
Then he opened his black wings.
"Now I need to make sure the Castellan doesn’t steal all your food."
A few moments later, he returned to the sky, but this time, his gaze remained fixed on the Nine-Venom Castellan.
The creature was still standing among the poisonous rings, and as soon as it saw Lian, it turned its head toward him.
As if it had been waiting for his return the entire time.
He gave a short smile.
"Well, now it’s not just you and me."
Then he looked toward the hundreds of remaining Withered.
"But first, I need to finish these."
He raised his right hand, the Bloodborne Calamity Domain was still active in parts of the battlefield, the red mist moved around the Withered’s feet and weakened their resistance.
Lian sent a new flow of mana into the domain.
The mist became denser, and then the golden light of the Hollow Sun turned dark across a large part of the battlefield.
[Corrupt Sun]
Dozens of threads of corrupted light formed in the sky.
But this time, instead of targeting each creature separately, he arranged the threads into a large network along the main paths where the Withered were moving.
The corrupted light settled on their defensive layers, and then Eclipse Energy began to weaken their mana structures, and just as their defenses became weaker, End Energy entered those same points.
The young Vorhelm closed his fingers.
BOOOOOOM!
Several paths collapsed from within at the same time.
The weakened bodies of the Withered were destroyed under the pressure of the energy, and a large part of the plain disappeared among dust and dark blood.
But other groups still remained.
Lian looked toward them.
"Next."
A new flow of dark light appeared, and once again, a large group of Withered fell to the ground, at the same time, the Devourer Egg continued feeding among the smoke.
Every corpse that came close to the black threads was slowly broken down, and its materials were transferred into the shell.
The Nine-Venom Castellan noticed the decrease in the number of creatures from a distance.
But what caught its attention even more was that some of the life energy from the corpses was no longer available to it.
The creature tilted its head slightly and then looked back at Lian, for a moment, the mana pressure around its crown increased.
But the young Vorhelm only smiled.
"Yeah, not everything is going to belong to you."
At that moment, the sound of breaking stone came from the north.
Lian turned his gaze.
Part of Rindo’s platform had cracked, and several Withered were moving toward it through a narrow path.
One was still busy in the south, and Two had to defend against attacks from two directions at the same time.
Rindo prepared his spear, but Lian noticed that one of the attackers was Level 50.
More trouble.
He was about to move toward the platform when the Nine-Venom Castellan quickly appeared in front of him, and the creature’s right claw moved toward his chest.
The young Vorhelm redirected the strike with his forearm, but white poison came out from around the claw and disrupted the defensive mana layer around his hand for a moment.
Then the second claw approached from a lower angle.
Lian was forced to move backward.
"This creature is deliberately not letting me get away from it." He frowned slightly.
Unlike Roderick, the Castellan did not attack without thinking.
Every time Lian tried to change his path, the creature used one of its poisons to limit his movement and forced him to move from another angle.
Even now, a dark blue stream had spread across the battlefield to make it harder to judge the creature’s real distance.
He narrowed his eyes for a moment and then gave a faint smile.
"Alright."
He lowered his right hand.
"Then let’s get a little more serious."
A huge flow of mana spread from around his body, and at that exact moment, black armor plates appeared one after another.
First on his arms, then his shoulders, and finally his chest and legs, the heavy pieces locked into place with metallic sounds, and the silver lines between them began to glow.
[World-Devourer Bastion]
Two black wings opened behind his armored body.
The Nine-Venom Castellan stopped for a moment, its gaze moved across the armor plates, and then it slowly lowered its head, while the nine poisonous streams around its body became denser.
But Lian did not wait any longer, his wings moved, and he flew toward his target at high speed.
BOOM!
He appeared directly in front of the Castellan, and his right fist moved toward its face covered by a bone mask.
The creature raised its hand.
But at the last moment, Lian changed the direction of his strike, and at that same moment, a huge ice claw covered his hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
His fist struck the side of the armor.
BAAANG!
Part of the black covering cracked.
The Castellan tried to retreat, but gravity increased in a small area around its body.
[Core of the Fallen Star]
The creature became heavier for a fraction of a second, and at that same moment, Lian drove his knee into its stomach.
BAAANG!
The Castellan’s four-meter-tall body left the ground, but before it could land on the stones, another punch from Lian struck its chest.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
BOOOOOOM!
A huge force passed through the point of impact and broke the creature’s natural armor from within, the Castellan was thrown several meters backward and struck one of the ancient pillars.
The pillar broke apart in the middle.
Even so, the monster had no chance to rest.
Two gray phantoms appeared one after another, and each of them struck it with a destructive punch before disappearing.
[Funeral of the Nameless]
The creature roared in pain and anger.
But this time, Lian did not even wait for the dust to settle, he moved toward the northern platform, and a few seconds later, landed in front of the Level 50 Withered.
The creature was about to attack Rindo with its thick arm.
But before it could reach him, the young Vorhelm grabbed its wrist, the Withered tried to free its hand, but he only increased the pressure of his fingers.
CRACK!
The bones in the creature’s arm broke.
Then Lian lifted its huge body from the ground with one movement and threw it toward the group of attackers behind it.
BAAANG!
Three Withered fell under the impact.
Rindo let out a short breath.
"Lian, there are still several more creatures here!"
The young Vorhelm nodded.
"I saw them."
He raised his hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
The huge ice claw passed through the narrow path and pushed several attackers backward.
Then Lian looked at his friend.
"Stay here, I don’t want to have to come back every few seconds."
Rindo looked at him for a moment and then tightened his grip on his spear.
"Don’t worry about me, just keep those two lunatics away from here."
"One of them really is crazy." Lian gave a short laugh.
But before he could even finish his sentence, familiar laughter came from the west.
"Hahahaha!"
Roderick had appeared again, he did not even pause when he saw the World-Devourer Bastion armor.
He simply charged toward Lian with his Ascended Mana.
The young Vorhelm let out a short sigh.
"You’re really getting annoying, I didn’t want to do this, but I guess you’ve left me no choice."
Sometimes, death was the only way to give someone peace.
And if his enemies refused to stop, Lian was more than willing to give them that peace himself.

The first thread reached the corpse of a Withered, and a few moments later, the creature’s body began to break down, and more threads started moving behind it.
Lian watched the scene for a moment.
"Good, you finally got a chance to eat as much as you want."
He knew the egg needed a large amount of monster remains to complete its growth, and now, hundreds of corpses were scattered across the battlefield.
It couldn’t get any better than this.
He kept the egg hidden behind several large rocks and among the thick smoke so that it would remain out of sight of Rindo and the attackers.
Then he opened his black wings.
"Now I need to make sure the Castellan doesn’t steal all your food."
A few moments later, he returned to the sky, but this time, his gaze remained fixed on the Nine-Venom Castellan.
The creature was still standing among the poisonous rings, and as soon as it saw Lian, it turned its head toward him.
As if it had been waiting for his return the entire time.
He gave a short smile.
"Well, now it’s not just you and me."
Then he looked toward the hundreds of remaining Withered.
"But first, I need to finish these."
He raised his right hand, the Bloodborne Calamity Domain was still active in parts of the battlefield, the red mist moved around the Withered’s feet and weakened their resistance.
Lian sent a new flow of mana into the domain.
The mist became denser, and then the golden light of the Hollow Sun turned dark across a large part of the battlefield.
[Corrupt Sun]
Dozens of threads of corrupted light formed in the sky.
But this time, instead of targeting each creature separately, he arranged the threads into a large network along the main paths where the Withered were moving.
The corrupted light settled on their defensive layers, and then Eclipse Energy began to weaken their mana structures, and just as their defenses became weaker, End Energy entered those same points.
The young Vorhelm closed his fingers.
BOOOOOOM!
Several paths collapsed from within at the same time.
The weakened bodies of the Withered were destroyed under the pressure of the energy, and a large part of the plain disappeared among dust and dark blood.
But other groups still remained.
Lian looked toward them.
"Next."
A new flow of dark light appeared, and once again, a large group of Withered fell to the ground, at the same time, the Devourer Egg continued feeding among the smoke.
Every corpse that came close to the black threads was slowly broken down, and its materials were transferred into the shell.
The Nine-Venom Castellan noticed the decrease in the number of creatures from a distance.
But what caught its attention even more was that some of the life energy from the corpses was no longer available to it.
The creature tilted its head slightly and then looked back at Lian, for a moment, the mana pressure around its crown increased.
But the young Vorhelm only smiled.
"Yeah, not everything is going to belong to you."
At that moment, the sound of breaking stone came from the north.
Lian turned his gaze.
Part of Rindo’s platform had cracked, and several Withered were moving toward it through a narrow path.
One was still busy in the south, and Two had to defend against attacks from two directions at the same time.
Rindo prepared his spear, but Lian noticed that one of the attackers was Level 50.
More trouble.
He was about to move toward the platform when the Nine-Venom Castellan quickly appeared in front of him, and the creature’s right claw moved toward his chest.
The young Vorhelm redirected the strike with his forearm, but white poison came out from around the claw and disrupted the defensive mana layer around his hand for a moment.
Then the second claw approached from a lower angle.
Lian was forced to move backward.
"This creature is deliberately not letting me get away from it." He frowned slightly.
Unlike Roderick, the Castellan did not attack without thinking.
Every time Lian tried to change his path, the creature used one of its poisons to limit his movement and forced him to move from another angle.
Even now, a dark blue stream had spread across the battlefield to make it harder to judge the creature’s real distance.
He narrowed his eyes for a moment and then gave a faint smile.
"Alright."
He lowered his right hand.
"Then let’s get a little more serious."
A huge flow of mana spread from around his body, and at that exact moment, black armor plates appeared one after another.
First on his arms, then his shoulders, and finally his chest and legs, the heavy pieces locked into place with metallic sounds, and the silver lines between them began to glow.
[World-Devourer Bastion]
Two black wings opened behind his armored body.
The Nine-Venom Castellan stopped for a moment, its gaze moved across the armor plates, and then it slowly lowered its head, while the nine poisonous streams around its body became denser.
But Lian did not wait any longer, his wings moved, and he flew toward his target at high speed.
BOOM!
He appeared directly in front of the Castellan, and his right fist moved toward its face covered by a bone mask.
The creature raised its hand.
But at the last moment, Lian changed the direction of his strike, and at that same moment, a huge ice claw covered his hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
His fist struck the side of the armor.
BAAANG!
Part of the black covering cracked.
The Castellan tried to retreat, but gravity increased in a small area around its body.
[Core of the Fallen Star]
The creature became heavier for a fraction of a second, and at that same moment, Lian drove his knee into its stomach.
BAAANG!
The Castellan’s four-meter-tall body left the ground, but before it could land on the stones, another punch from Lian struck its chest.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
BOOOOOOM!
A huge force passed through the point of impact and broke the creature’s natural armor from within, the Castellan was thrown several meters backward and struck one of the ancient pillars.
The pillar broke apart in the middle.
Even so, the monster had no chance to rest.
Two gray phantoms appeared one after another, and each of them struck it with a destructive punch before disappearing.
[Funeral of the Nameless]
The creature roared in pain and anger.
But this time, Lian did not even wait for the dust to settle, he moved toward the northern platform, and a few seconds later, landed in front of the Level 50 Withered.
The creature was about to attack Rindo with its thick arm.
But before it could reach him, the young Vorhelm grabbed its wrist, the Withered tried to free its hand, but he only increased the pressure of his fingers.
CRACK!
The bones in the creature’s arm broke.
Then Lian lifted its huge body from the ground with one movement and threw it toward the group of attackers behind it.
BAAANG!
Three Withered fell under the impact.
Rindo let out a short breath.
"Lian, there are still several more creatures here!"
The young Vorhelm nodded.
"I saw them."
He raised his hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
The huge ice claw passed through the narrow path and pushed several attackers backward.
Then Lian looked at his friend.
"Stay here, I don’t want to have to come back every few seconds."
Rindo looked at him for a moment and then tightened his grip on his spear.
"Don’t worry about me, just keep those two lunatics away from here."
"One of them really is crazy." Lian gave a short laugh.
But before he could even finish his sentence, familiar laughter came from the west.
"Hahahaha!"
Roderick had appeared again, he did not even pause when he saw the World-Devourer Bastion armor.
He simply charged toward Lian with his Ascended Mana.
The young Vorhelm let out a short sigh.
"You’re really getting annoying, I didn’t want to do this, but I guess you’ve left me no choice."
Sometimes, death was the only way to give someone peace.
And if his enemies refused to stop, Lian was more than willing to give them that peace himself.

paragraphs: [You have killed a Level 41 Withered]

[You have...]
Lian ignored the notifications, it was time to put an end to something once and for all.
Then he moved toward Roderick.
The first clash between them was so powerful that the stone ground beneath their feet cracked.
Roderick had gained speed with Tyrant’s Advance and had now gathered all his strength into his right fist.
Lian blocked the strike with his armored forearm.
[Mountain Anchor]
The armor’s structure became fixed to the ground for a moment, and the force of the impact spread through its plates and the stones beneath his feet.
BAAANG!
Cracks appeared around the young Vorhelm’s feet, but he did not even move backward.
The young Ashen raised his elbow, and Lian placed his other hand in front of the strike.
CRACK!
Then Roderick’s final punch, strengthened with Ascended Mana, moved toward his chest.
[Crushing Decree]
The strike hit the armor plates, and a moment later, the second explosion occurred.
BOOOOM!
One of the outer plates cracked.
[Structural Memory Activated]
The glowing lines lit up, and the damaged part began to repair itself.
But when Roderick saw the crack in the armor, he laughed loudly.
"Hahaha! Finally!"
Lian looked at his forearm for a moment and then raised his head.
"Are you really happy about just that?"
Roderick threw another punch, but this time, Lian did not even let him complete the strike, his left hand closed around Roderick’s wrist, and then he lifted his right foot from the ground.
[Mountain Anchor: Released]
The armor’s huge weight was transferred into his next movement.
[Giant’s Momentum]
The young Vorhelm’s right fist struck the young Ashen’s chest.
BOOOOOOM!

He was thrown backward, and his body moved several meters through the air before finally hitting the ground, but before he could completely stop, two gray figures appeared along the path of that same punch.
[Funeral of the Nameless]
The first phantom punch struck Roderick’s body.
BAAANG!
Then the second.
BOOOM!
The young Ashen’s body slid across the stones and finally stopped near the edge of one of the cracks.
Lian looked at him for several seconds, if he was still in his right mind, he should surrender right here.
But even now, Roderick was still trying to stand up, he placed his hand on the ground, and blood ran down from his mouth.
And then...
"Ha... hahaha..."
A weak laugh came from his throat.
Lian lowered his head slightly, there was no longer any sign of amusement on his face, he slowly walked toward Roderick.
The young Ashen raised his head.
When he saw Lian’s black-armored figure standing in front of him, his laughter stopped for a moment, but a few seconds later, his blood-covered teeth appeared again.
"Vorhelm..."
Lian did not answer and only looked at him.
Roderick stood up with difficulty, white and golden mana gathered around his arms.
"I... am the king..." He lost his balance for a moment and then raised his head again.
"And you..."
Lian took a step forward, and Roderick instinctively stepped backward.
The young Vorhelm tilted his head for a moment.
"What about me?"
Roderick clenched his teeth.
"You should... be beneath my feet!"
Then he attacked with all his remaining strength, but this time, Lian did not even allow the fist to get close to him.
[Core of the Fallen Star]
Gravity increased around Roderick’s body, his movement stopped for a moment, and then Lian raised his right hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
Five huge ice blades formed in the air.
Roderick tried to escape their range with Ascended Mana, but the pressure of gravity and his previous injuries prevented him from reacting in time.
Lian lowered his hand.
SLASH!
The first strike passed through Roderick’s right arm, blood splashed onto the stones, and his strengthened fist was separated from his body before it could reach its target.
Roderick looked at the place where his hand had been for a moment.
His laughter stopped.
But Lian did not stop, and the second blade moved from the opposite angle.
SLASH!
His left arm was also separated from his body.
He had lost both of his arms.
Roderick took several unsteady steps backward, his gaze moved between his two bloody shoulders. For the first time since his madness began, his face showed something other than anger and laughter.
Fear...
But Lian was not finished yet.
"All these years..."
His voice was calm.
Roderick raised his head.
"You thought humiliating others could prove that you were a king."
The young Vorhelm moved his right hand again, and the two remaining ice blades moved toward Roderick’s legs.
SLASH!
The young Ashen lost his balance, his knees bent, and his body fell to the ground...he had lost both of his legs as well.
He could no longer stand.
He could no longer throw punches.
And he could not even move himself away from the edge of the crack.
Lian stood in front of him, his black armor shining under the golden sunlight.
Roderick looked at him with broken breaths.
"Vorhelm..."
"But the problem is that you’re nothing more than a piece of trash who dreams of becoming a king." The young Vorhelm remained silent for a moment and then spoke.
Roderick tried to say something, but only a weak sound came from his throat.
Lian slowly extended his hand, gravity changed in a small area around Roderick’s body, and the injured young man’s body rose from the ground.
For a moment, his gaze fell on the huge crack behind him, molten lava flowed in its depths, and farther below, the remains of ancient structures could be seen among the smoke and darkness.
Those ancient remains beneath the lava were probably the same structures that had kept the Withered inside them.
For the first time, Roderick looked at Lian with fear instead of laughter.
He was afraid.
He didn’t want to die! He had not become a king yet, he had not achieved his ambition yet.
How did this happen? How had everything reached this point? Where had he gone wrong? Was his dream of becoming a king foolish? But he had to become a king!
He was the only one worthy of becoming a king, he had made every sacrifice necessary to achieve his dream.
He had even sold his body to those unknown voices in his head, just to gain the power to kill this bastard.
Then why... why had he still lost...?
Lian’s expression did not change.
"Goodbye, Roderick."
Then he changed the direction of gravity, and the young Ashen’s body moved toward the crack.
Roderick tried to pull himself backward, but he no longer had arms or legs to support himself, and his body passed over the edge...and fell into the depths.
For several seconds, only the sound of his body hitting the stones sticking out from the walls could be heard.
Then a heavier impact occurred deep inside the crack.
Before reaching the flowing lava, Roderick struck one of the buried stone platforms, his injured body could no longer survive that impact, and his final breath ended there.
Roderick Ashen died.
What remained among the smoke and ancient structures below was now nothing more than his lifeless body.
The lava rose and completely swallowed him.
Lian looked into the darkness of the crack for a few moments and then raised his head, there was no smile on his face.
But that long and unpleasant part of his past had finally come to an end.
He no longer even needed to think about Roderick, because another enemy still remained, and that enemy was now moving toward him from farther away with all nine of its poisonous streams.
Lian looked at the crack for several seconds, and then the sound of heavy movement from the east caught his attention.
The Nine-Venom Castellan was still on the battlefield.
The Unholy creature walked slowly among the corpses.
Parts of its chest armor had been destroyed by that human’s previous punches, but now dark streams moved around the wounds and tried to repair the damage.
Even so, the Castellan was no longer as calm as it had been when it first appeared.
The nine blades of its crown were glowing, and poisonous streams were coming out of the gaps in its armor with much greater pressure.
Lian noticed that the creature was using a considerable amount of its stored life energy.
"So you can’t keep this going much longer either."
The Castellan lowered its head slightly and then opened both hands to its sides, nine poisonous streams came out of its body and slowly began moving through the sky.
But this time, unlike its previous attacks, the streams did not immediately move toward the young Vorhelm.
Instead, they formed rings around the creature.
The first ring was emerald green, the second was purple, the third was gray, and in the same way, nine huge, semi-transparent rings formed behind the Castellan.
From a distance, the scene looked like a heavenly crown made of poison, but its beauty did not make it any less dangerous.
The stones beneath the emerald ring began to break down, and the mana flows near the purple ring became unstable.
And even the Withered farther away began moving more slowly as the gray mist approached them.
Lian narrowed his eyes for a moment.
It released all its poisons at the same time, he knew this attack could be extremely dangerous, not because each poison alone had enough power to destroy him.
But because their combination could target his different defenses at the same time.
If the white poison weakened his defensive mana layers, the emerald poison would have a chance to damage his armor plates.
If the purple poison disrupted his mana flow, the gray and black poisons could reduce his muscle movements and reactions.
And if a wound was created, the red and golden poisons would prevent it from healing easily, all these effects could eventually create an opening for the ninth poison to enter.
Lian slowly breathed out.
"Very well."
He raised his right hand.
"Let’s see how long you can last."
But at that exact moment, the sound of breaking stone came from the north.
CRAAAACK!
A large part of Rindo’s platform began to break away.
Two jumped away from the dangerous area, but its landing path was blocked by several Level 45 to Level 50 Withered.
One was also still busy in the south.
Lian immediately examined the situation, in front of him, the Castellan was preparing its main attack, while to the north, Rindo did not have enough space to retreat.
And around the battlefield, dozens of remaining Withered were still moving toward the stable paths.
Damn it.
He could use his wings to fly toward Rindo, but in that case, the Castellan would have the chance to send all nine poisonous streams across the battlefield without interference.
And if he continued fighting the Castellan, Rindo would be forced to pass through several stronger enemies along with Two.
He looked at the Hollow Sun for a moment.
The time of the next Judgment was approaching, he knew this very well, but right now, he only had a few seconds.
He raised his right hand.
[Hive Dominion]
Streams of mana formed beside the northern platform.
And a moment later, the Dreadmaw Sovereign appeared among them.
Three.

chapters.title: Chapter 661: Not Yours To Judge
paragraphs: Three.
The Unholy creature landed heavily on the stones, but immediately raised its head and saw the Hollow Sun.
Its entire body became stiff, its hands trembled, and a wave of fear was sent to Lian through the Colony Link.
The same reaction again.
But this time, Lian did not even have time to calm it down.
"Three!"
The Dreadmaw Sovereign lowered its head with difficulty.
"M-Master..."
He pointed toward the broken path in front of Rindo.
"Just hold that path for a few moments, then I’ll send you back."
Three looked at the sun for a moment and then raised both hands despite its trembling body.
"I... obey."
[Ossuary Gravefield]
Huge bone pillars rose from the stone surface of the northern platform.
These pillars were part of the Dreadmaw Sovereign’s battlefield control abilities and could block the paths of enemies.
Several Withered that were trying to cross the narrow path became trapped behind the pillars.
Three then extended its right hand.
[Crimson Decree]
A red beam was released from its hand and struck the group of attackers, throwing several creatures backward.
Two used the opportunity.
Its huge claws pressed firmly against the stone, and with a long jump, it carried Rindo to a higher platform in the north.
Lian noticed that his friend had escaped the dangerous area.
Good.
But just as he was about to praise the newest member of his colony...
The wind stopped.
The sound of the golden leaves moving disappeared.
And the Withered that had been attacking the humans with rough roars only moments earlier almost simultaneously turned their heads toward the sky.
Lian remained still for a moment.
It had arrived.

The mana flows around One, Two, and Three changed at the same time.

Three’s body began to disappear just as the identification light reached the place where it was standing.

Emerald from the left, purple from the right, gray from below, and the other streams from different angles.

CRAAACK!

The gravity of several large pieces changed.

BOOM!

The monster immediately raised its right claw.

BAAANG!
The armored joint broke, and the Castellan’s arm bent at an unnatural angle, the creature let out a rough roar and tried to raise its other hand.
But Lian had already moved first, and his second punch struck its shoulder.
BAAANG!
Several plates of natural armor broke, and then the young Vorhelm turned his body.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
The ice claw passed along the Castellan’s side.
SLASH!
Three deep cuts appeared across the creature’s armor and body, and dark liquid came out from beneath the broken plates.

The poisonous streams stopped for a moment.
Lian noticed the change.
Is it going to try something else?
At that moment, the almost colorless poison spread from around the Castellan, not in the form of ordinary vapor, but as very thin threads moving across the ground.
The threads reached the remaining Withered corpses and then passed through them.
Through [True Sequence], Lian noticed that these streams were extracting the remaining life energy.
The ninth poison again.

The young Vorhelm glanced across the battlefield.
Some of the corpses were still inside the smoke; the same place where the Devourer Egg was feeding.

The red mist became denser again in the central part of the battlefield.
Then Lian used Corrupt Sun to corrupt the surrounding light along several paths.
Threads of dark light descended from the sky and struck the corpses that the ninth poison’s streams were approaching.
But Lian’s goal was not to destroy the corpses, he was targeting the structure of the life-absorbing threads, and Eclipse Energy began to weaken them.
He would not let anyone disturb his precious egg.

The young Vorhelm gave a faint smile.
"What’s wrong? Did I take your food away?"
The monster raised both hands with clear anger, and the nine poisonous rings appeared behind it again, but this time, all of them moved toward Lian at the same time.
The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes.
’So you finally got angry.’
He opened his black wings.
But before he could move, several remaining Withered approached him from the south.
However, he did not even turn his head toward them and simply slammed his fist into the ground.
BOOOOM!
A crack spread directly along the attackers’ path, and several Withered lost their balance.
Then mana pressure was released from beneath their feet and threw their bodies into the air.
But Lian was not finished yet.
Mana gathered in front of his hand, and a group of hard ice spears formed, then with a movement of his hand, dozens of spears were thrown toward the attackers.
SLASH!
The spears passed through the bodies of several Withered and pinned them to the stone surface behind them.
Another group tried to escape the attack, but the Bloodborne Calamity Domain had already reduced their body’s coordination.
A few moments later, most of the remaining attackers had also fallen.
[You have killed a Level 46 Withered]
[You have killed a Level 39 Withered]
[You have killed a Level 43 Withered]
The EXP messages continued to appear.
But he no longer paid attention to them, because the nine poisonous streams had now reached a short distance from him.
He raised his right hand.
[Thunder Calamity]

Purple and blue lightning moved along his armor, and then Lian used the Wings of God to leave the ground, at the moment the poisonous streams reached his previous position, he flew down toward the Castellan at high speed.
The Unholy creature immediately raised its head, but it was already too late.
[Giant’s Momentum]
The armor’s huge weight gathered along his fall, and Lian’s right fist struck directly into the damaged part of the Castellan’s chest.
BOOOOOOM!
The creature’s four-meter-tall body was slammed into the ground, the stones beneath it were crushed, and several deep cracks spread around the point of impact.
But the young Vorhelm did not allow the Castellan to stand up, he pulled his right hand backward.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
Mana gathered in several layers along his fist, and the strike hit the Castellan’s chest.
CRACK!
The remaining armor cracked.
BAAANG!
The structures beneath the armor were damaged.
BOOOOM!
A large part of the chest plates was destroyed, but this time, Lian was not satisfied with that and attacked again, not just once, but his fists struck the creature repeatedly, one after another.
BOOOOOOM!
The Castellan’s body sank into a deep crater.
Thick dust covered the battlefield, and for several seconds, even the nine poisonous rings in the sky became unstable.
But the creature was still alive, and that was exactly what Lian wanted.
’Good, you’re still holding on.’
He did not intend to kill the Castellan.
At least not now.
Because from the moment he saw its Unholy rank and nine different abilities, another possibility had entered his mind.
A new member for the colony.

But before that, he had to push the creature to the point where it could no longer fight, and the Nine-Venom Castellan still had no intention of surrendering, from within the dust, a deep roar was heard.
Then the poisonous streams began moving again.
This time, the Castellan was using the last of its stored life energy to repair parts of its damaged armor.
But the repair was not complete.
One of its arms was still broken, a large part of its chest was still exposed, and several blades of its crown were cracked.
Even so, the creature slowly climbed out of the crater, its height was still impressive, and its glowing eyes were still staring at Lian.
And even now, despite its serious injuries, it refused to lower its head.
The young Vorhelm looked at it for a moment and then gave a short smile.
"You’re stubborn.
The Castellan did not answer, but at that exact moment, the colorless stream of the ninth poison spread from around its body.
This time, instead of moving toward the corpses, it approached Lian directly.
The young Vorhelm immediately noticed the change.
’It wants to feed on me?’
Lian did not know whether this poison could extract life energy without killing its target, but he had no intention of letting the stream reach his body just to find out.
He raised his left hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
The ice claw moved quickly toward the Castellan, the creature tried to move out of its path, but at that exact moment, gravity increased around its right foot.
[Core of the Fallen Star]
Its movement slowed, and the claw struck its damaged shoulder.
SLASH!
and one of the long blades behind its shoulder was cut off.
The Castellan roared, but Lian did not wait any longer, his wings pushed him forward.
BOOM!
In less than a moment, he appeared in front of the creature, and his right fist struck the Castellan’s stomach.
BAAANG!
Then his left elbow struck the side of its bone mask.
CRACK!
A deep crack spread from the side of the creature’s face to its chin, and the monster tried to move its healthy claw toward him.
But the young Vorhelm grabbed its wrist and then pulled it downward with huge force.
BAAANG!
The creature’s knees hit the stone, the ground cracked under its weight, and for a moment, the Castellan tried to stand up again.
But gravity increased around its body.
Lian took a step forward, the Glacial Reaper Claw was still active around his right hand, and he held the ice blades in front of the Castellan’s neck.
The sharp edges were only a few centimeters away from the creature’s skin.
The Castellan remained motionless for a moment, the nine poisonous streams were still moving around its body, but none of them attacked Lian anymore.
The young Vorhelm looked at the creature’s damaged face.
"Well."
